name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux from PyPI through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc22): four tools that had stopped working on Acumatica 2026 R1 work again. Building a workgroup on the Company Tree, adding a member to one, building an approval map and editing a step of one all drove a page style that version removed, so on 2026 R1 they failed before doing anything; earlier versions were unaffected and still take the original route. Approval maps also get their amount conditions back ('this approver above RM10,000'), and a multi-step map now gets one approver rule per step instead of leaving the second step with none. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
